title: UI Library
features:
I have prepared a "Blank Hub" (UI Library) framework that works flawlessly with mobile executors like Delta, Fluxus, CodeX, Hydrogen, and Vega X, and is fully compatible with touch controls.
This framework doesn't take up much screen space on mobile, supports drag-and-drop, and features a small, fixed toggle button on the screen so you can hide the menu while playing the game. At the very bottom of the code block, I've left an example structure showing how to insert your own scripts.
